notes: The dataset's clearest DOWNWARD repricer: Ultra cut $249.99→$200 (May 2026), Plus cut $7.99→$4.99 with doubled storage (June 2026). Heavy bundling (storage, YouTube Premium, Cloud credits) makes effective price analysis unusually complex. Compute-based limits with model-downgrade soft landing.

change_events.description: I/O 2026: Ultra restructured — new $100/mo Ultra tier (5x limits) introduced and top tier cut from $249.99 to $200/mo. Lineage: Feb 2024 'Google One AI Premium' $19.99 → May 2025 rebrand to AI Pro + Ultra launch at $249.99 → Jan 2026 Plus tier ($7.99) → these cuts. One Premium subscribers grandfathered with 2TB.
AI Plus cut from $7.99 (Jan 2026 launch price) to $4.99/mo with storage doubled to 400GB.
